description: Image Description: The image depicts a living room with a stone fireplace as the focal point on the right side. The fireplace is made of light-colored stones and has a brass or gold-colored frame around its glass doors. On the mantel, there is a small decorative item. To the right of the fireplace, a wicker basket containing artificial flowers is placed on the hearth. In the foreground, a richly patterned area rug covers part of the wooden floor. To the left, a small wooden side table is visible
